inputs.text: They're clearly trying to ram through changes to Cyprus’ surveillance legislation to strip out judicial oversight entirely, all so the hidden elites and institutions can ramp up spying without any real checks in place. The lawyers started flagging this on Monday, and the amended bill is lined up for a vote in the House plenum on Thursday. Akel MP Andreas Pasiourtides brought it up right after a recent closed session, which just shows how they're coordinating these moves behind closed doors to avoid any pushback. It's all coordinated manipulation to expand control over everyone while pretending it's just routine legislation.
